description: Establish the green baseline for Phase 5 Step 2. Confirm the existing engine, iOS type-checks, clippy and the switch-wrapper harness all pass before any change, so every later regression is attributable. This is a verification-only feature: it makes NO source edits. It exists because the four later features must each leave this baseline intact.
steps: Run `cargo test` from the repo root and confirm 74 tests pass.
Run `cargo check --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings` and confirm it type-checks cleanly on Linux (it does not link, which is expected).
Run `cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings` and confirm the custom ios profile also type-checks.

Run `cargo clippy --features native-core,uniffi-bindings --all-targets` and confirm zero warnings (CI runs it with -D warnings; touch a source file if clippy prints a cached 'Finished' without re-emitting).

Run `./scripts/fetch-libretro-headers.sh` to populate .work/hdr/libretro/ (network to raw.githubusercontent.com is available), then run `./native/switch-wrapper/build.sh host` and confirm the harness reports 15/15 checks passed.
Record the baseline results in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: Both `cargo check` invocations (default and --profile ios) for aarch64-apple-ios succeed.
No source files were modified by this feature.
findings: Baseline verified green by the orchestrator before any edit. cargo test: 74 passed, 0 failed. cargo check --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings: type-checks cleanly (no link, expected). cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings: clean. cargo clippy --features native-core,uniffi-bindings --all-targets: no warnings. ./scripts/fetch-libretro-headers.sh fetched libretro.h + libretro_vulkan.h into .work/hdr/libretro (raw.githubusercontent.com reachable). ./native/switch-wrapper/build.sh host: 15/15 checks passed. Toolchain: Rust 1.92.0 pinned; installed targets include aarch64-apple-ios and wasm32-unknown-unknown. No source files modified.
